item.title: MATH4SPORTS — Mathematical Modelling for the Sports Industry
item.description:
Funding: Provincial Council of Bizkaia
Institution: BCAM
Role: Principal Investigator
Budget: 151,328.94 €
Period: June 2022 – July 2024

Promote applied mathematical research into the challenges of today’s sport, with the main focus on the health and performance of athletes.

item.title: Basque Modeling Task Force (BMTF) — Mathematical Modelling Applied to Health
item.description:
Funding: Basque Government (COVID-19 projects)
Role: Responsible for several working packages

Multidisciplinary task force created in March 2020 to assist Basque Health managers and the Basque Government during the COVID-19 response, combining stochastic processes, statistical methods and artificial intelligence.

item.title: Mathematical Modelling Advisory Service for SMEs
item.description:
Funding: Provincial Council of Bizkaia
Institution: BCAM
Role: Coordinator of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence projects
Budget: 180,000 €

Advisory service in mathematical modelling for SMEs and startups in Bizkaia (data diagnostics and modelling support).
